# Collect customer feedback: Telegram

**Pattern:** Survey & Feedback · **Level:** Intermediate · **Trigger:** Scheduled

## Overview

Runs on a schedule, and covers feedback work end to end across Telegram and Google Drive.

It moves through 9 working steps, in this order:

1. Hourly Schedule
2. Gather from Google Drive
3. Roll Up KPIs
4. Write Executive Summary (AI)
5. OpenAI Chat Model
6. Compose HTML Report
7. Send Report via Telegram
8. Sort Tickets Newest First
9. Send Summary to Telegram

## Why it exists

Doing feedback work by hand is slow and easy to get wrong, and it stops entirely when the person who does it is away. This makes the process repeatable and monitored, with failures surfaced instead of silently lost.

## Main flow

Hourly Schedule → Gather from Google Drive → Roll Up KPIs → Write Executive Summary (AI) → OpenAI Chat Model → Compose HTML Report → Send Report via Telegram → Sort Tickets Newest First → Send Summary to Telegram

## Use it for

- Teams keeping Telegram and Google Drive aligned by hand for feedback
- Feedback work where "Gather from Google Drive" is still a manual step before Telegram
- Feedback work that only reaches Telegram on a schedule, when someone remembers to start it

## You get

- Keeps Telegram and Google Drive in step for feedback, without anyone re-typing a row
- A failed Telegram or Google Drive call is retried rather than dropped, at any of the 9 nodes in this feedback build
- The feedback AI step is isolated from Telegram, so models swap without touching the other 9 nodes
- Pinned sample data ships with it — run all 9 nodes for feedback before wiring Telegram
- 9 nodes, each with a doc card explaining what it does for feedback

## Before first run
Connect credentials: Google OAuth2; OpenAI API key; Telegram bot token.
Follow the color key: 🟦 entry · 🟪 AI · 🟫 actions · ⬜ utilities · 🟩 outputs · 🟥 error rail.
Each node has its own doc card underneath — read those before editing.

## Try it now
Sample data is pinned on the trigger — hit **Execute Workflow** to watch it flow through every node before connecting any real credentials. Unpin the trigger (right-click → Unpin) when you're ready to go live.

## Design decisions

KPIs are rolled up with Summarize (exact group-by + aggregate) before any AI touches the data — asking an LLM to 'figure out the numbers' from raw records is slower, costlier, and less reliable than doing exact arithmetic in n8n and only asking the model to narrate numbers that are already correct.

## Practice exercises

New to this pattern? Try these in order:

1. Add a second data source and watch it blend into the same report via Merge.
2. Toggle the AI executive-summary step on and off and compare the report's usefulness.
3. Change the KPI grouping field and see how the pivot reshapes.

## Credentials setup

Credentials are never included in a template file, so every node below needs its own connection before the first real run. In n8n: open the node, click the Credential dropdown, choose **Create new**.

**Google OAuth2**
Google Cloud Console → enable Drive API → OAuth2 client or Service Account.
_Gotcha:_ Service Accounts have their own empty Drive — share the target folder with it.

**OpenAI API key**
platform.openai.com → API keys → create new secret key.
_Gotcha:_ Needs billing set up; a brand-new key with no credit returns 429 immediately.

**Telegram bot token**
Message @BotFather on Telegram → /newbot → copy the token.
_Gotcha:_ Get your chat ID by messaging the bot then opening api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates.

Set each credential up once and it is reusable across every workflow in your instance.

## Troubleshooting

**Workflow does nothing when the trigger should fire**
Cause: It is still a draft, or the trigger is inactive.
Fix: Publish/activate the workflow. Manual test runs use a different URL than production.

**A node shows a red error triangle on import**
Cause: No credential is attached yet.
Fix: Expected on a fresh import — open the node and attach a credential (see the Credentials setup note).

**AI node fails with an auth or quota error**
Cause: API key missing billing, or the per-minute rate limit was hit.
Fix: Confirm the provider account has credit. For rate limits, lower concurrency or switch to a higher-quota model.

**The AI returns the wrong shape or rambles**
Cause: The prompt is under-specified for the task.
Fix: Tighten the System Message: state the role, the constraints, and the exact output format you expect.

Still stuck? n8n's **Executions** tab shows the exact node that failed and the data going into it — start there rather than guessing.

## 🛟 When this fails

This starter workflow keeps things simple: no automatic retry or error branch yet. If a node fails, the execution just stops — open n8n's **Executions** tab to see which node and why. Ready to harden it? Turn on **Retry On Fail** (3 tries, 2s backoff) on the Settings tab of each external node, and add an error-output branch to a Slack/email alert — every Production-tier template in this library shows that exact pattern.

## 🤖 AI cluster

Purple nodes form one AI unit: the root node orchestrates, sub-nodes plug in via typed ports (model / memory / tools / parser). Swap the chat model without rewiring anything else. Costs scale with tokens — keep prompts lean and cap iterations.

## 🛠 Customize me

Quick wins: point the data nodes at your own accounts (see 🔑 lines on each card), adjust the trigger cadence, and tune thresholds/labels to your feedback process. Every node card explains its role — safe to extend at any marked branch.

## 🔐 Security

Credentials live in n8n's credential store and are never written into node parameters — that is why this file carries none.

**Least privilege for this build**
- Telegram: the bot token is a bearer credential — rotate it if it ever appears in an execution log.
- Google Drive: scope the credential to the one folder this workflow writes to, not `drive.readonly` across the account.

**Do not log**
feedback payloads carry personal data (names, email addresses, phone numbers). Log the record id and the outcome, not the record. n8n retains full execution data by default — turn that down for this workflow in Settings → Executions if these runs touch real contacts.
